headline: 3 three men arrested in Adabor while preparing for robbery
summary: Police recovered three cleavers from the suspects in the Mehedibagh Housing area of Dhaka.
details: Adabor police arrested three men on Saturday afternoon from the canal bank area of Mehedibagh Housing in the capital.
The arrested individuals have been identified as Md. Shakil (25), Md. Nayan Matubbor (28), and Md. Yasin (25).
During the arrest, police recovered three cleavers from their possession.
According to police sources, the operation was carried out based on secret information that a gang of robbers were preparing for a heist using samurai swords, cleavers, and local weapons.
The suspects have multiple existing cases against them in Adabor and Madaripur Sadar police stations, including charges of extortion and attempted murder.
Specifically, Shakil and Yasin each have one case filed against them at Adabor police station, while Nayan has two cases filed at Madaripur Sadar police station.
caption:
Three men were caught red-handed with cleavers while planning a robbery in Dhaka's Adabor.

Adabor police arrested three men on Saturday afternoon from the canal bank area of Mehedibagh Housing in the capital.

The arrested individuals have been identified as Md. Shakil (25), Md. Nayan Matubbor (28), and Md. Yasin (25).

During the arrest, police recovered three cleavers from their possession.

According to police sources, the operation was carried out based on secret information that a gang of robbers were preparing for a heist using samurai swords, cleavers, and local weapons.

The suspects have multiple existing cases against them in Adabor and Madaripur Sadar police stations, including charges of extortion and attempted murder.

Specifically, Shakil and Yasin each have one case filed against them at Adabor police station, while Nayan has two cases filed at Madaripur Sadar police station.

#Dhaka #CrimeNews #Adabor #Bangladesh #PoliceAction

Source: Prothom Alo

headline_marked: World Cup fever: [[Argentina wins again]] in newsroom match
headline: World Cup fever: Argentina wins again in newsroom match
summary: Journalists and staff members gear up for a friendly football match inspired by the World Cup spirit.
details: The World Cup fever has reached the newsroom, leading to a friendly football match among staff members.
Employees divided themselves into teams, with many wearing jerseys of their favorite international teams, including Argentina and Brazil.
The match served as a team-building exercise and a way to celebrate the global football tournament's excitement.
In a spirited competition, the team representing Argentina emerged victorious once again.
caption:
World Cup fever hits the newsroom! ⚽️

The World Cup fever has reached the newsroom, leading to a friendly football match among staff members.

Employees divided themselves into teams, with many wearing jerseys of their favorite international teams, including Argentina and Brazil.

The match served as a team-building exercise and a way to celebrate the global football tournament's excitement.

In a spirited competition, the team representing Argentina emerged victorious once again.

#WorldCup #Football #NewsroomLife #Argentina #SportsNews

Source: Dhaka Tribune
